let tripPrayerPlayed=false, tripPrayerActive=false, resumeNasheed=false;
function throttleReady(){
  return game.engineOn&&game.fuel>0&&(game.gear==="D"||game.gear==="R");
}
function playTripPrayer(){
  if(tripPrayerPlayed||!game.started||game.ended||game.pedestrian||!throttleReady()||!keys.has("up"))return;
  tripPrayerPlayed=true;
  tripPrayerActive=true;
  resumeNasheed=!audio.paused;
  if(resumeNasheed)audio.pause();
  mediaState();
  tripPrayer.play().catch(finishTripPrayer);
}
function finishTripPrayer(){
  if(!tripPrayerActive)return;
  tripPrayerActive=false;
  const resume=resumeNasheed;resumeNasheed=false;
  if(resume)selectTrack(trackIndex,true);
  else mediaState();
}
for(const event of ["ended","pause","error"])tripPrayer.addEventListener(event,finishTripPrayer);
